description: This file defines the 'VoiceSessionCoordinator' class, responsible for managing voice recognition sessions in a macOS application. It handles starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing voice sessions, interacts with overlay controllers, and manages session state information.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for coordinating voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, sending, dismissing, and capturing session state.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Begins a new voice recognition session with specified source, text, and options, generating a UUID token to identify the session.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the ongoing voice session with partial transcription text and optional attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the current session, marking it as complete, updating state, and presenting the final transcript with optional auto-send delay.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Forces immediate sending of the current transcript; dismisses if transcript is empty.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session based on a token, with a specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the audio input level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session token, text, and overlay visibility status.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles overlay dismissal, clearing the session and refreshing runtime state.
